_comment: Informal description (not validated by a JSON Schema engine) of the role contract lib/role_contract_validator.py consumes. A contract declares what an agent may touch; the validator compares that with what actually changed.

model.note: model the agent runs on; a test keeps it in sync with the role file

tools.note: allowed tools; enforced by the role file's frontmatter, not by this validator

forbidden_paths.note: fnmatch patterns (** supported) this role may never touch, on top of ALWAYS_FORBIDDEN

may_write.note: fnmatch patterns of the only paths the role may write. When it is empty or absent AND no --scope-glob was passed, no allowlist applies (only forbidden_paths is checked)

may_spawn.note: which other roles this agent may launch; hooks/guard_spawn.py denies any launch outside this list

handoff_targets.note: which role or roles it may hand its work to

output.changed_paths: sorted list of every changed path evaluated
output.forbidden_hits: [{path, pattern}]: paths that matched a forbidden pattern (ALWAYS_FORBIDDEN or the contract's forbidden_paths)
output.outside_allowlist: paths that, with an allowlist active (non-empty may_write and/or --scope-glob), matched no allowed pattern
output.verdict: PASS | FAIL: FAIL when forbidden_hits or outside_allowlist is not empty
